script_text: Stop everything, Libra, because this week the cosmic scales have officially tipped in your favor starting today. Early week brings Venus in your first House while Mars squares Saturn from your tenth, making Monday and Tuesday tense for career negotiations and deadlines. Do not sign important contracts yet; your air energy clouds judgment. Wednesday is the turning point as the North Node conjuncts Venus, marking a powerful, fated connection or a major self-reinvention moment. Late week sees the Sun enter your sign, empowering you to negotiate a higher pay raise in your second House by Saturday. Weekend new romance blooms under the Moon. Wednesday is your power day because the North Node activates your first House. Tuesday is your hardest day because Mars opposes your inner peace. Trust your air sign intuition always over a rigid plan when Venus rules. Follow for daily astrological updates.
